comment: Dr. Brinkerhoff is great. Very knowledgeable, approachable, and caring. The eco-epi assignments are straight-forward with no surprises. A few presentations w/ loads of citations, take-home quiz, one test, opportunity to create your own project, and no final exam. Would recommend for anyone who needs a low-stress bio elective.
Awesome professor, class was interesting and had a lot of student presentations. He has clear expectations on assignments and is helpful outside of class.
I love Dr. Brinkerhoff, he has lived a thousand lives with the stories he tells. His class was so much fun and he really loves what he teaches. I would give him my kidney if he needed it.

I enjoyed this professor & recommend taking him! His class is pretty easy: isn't much homework, tests are pretty light, & he is super nice & approachable. I would suggest for his tests to not focus too much on all the details but instead, to try understand the over arching concepts. Also, try to participate a lot as that will help your grade!

Dr. Brinkerhoff has been my favorite professor at UR so far. He really cares about his students and how they are doing, more than just their letter grade. He will explain things to you 50 times if he has to. After the class was over he invited us to his house for a pizza party. He is an awesome professor and I hope I can take him again soon.

Really cares about students and their workload. Is willing to move deadlines based on feedback from students/occurrence of campus events. A great lecturer, moderates good discussions. A couple group projects, minimal tests. Very nice person and a great professor. Would recommend!

Jory was my favorite professor at UR! He makes biology so easy to understand. There are a few assignments that require you to put some work in but if you take your time and study and work on your projects you will do just fine! He's also super nice and everyone loves him!!
Jory is an awesome professor. I took his Biology of Mammals intro course and it was phenomenal. The class was super interesting and easy!

best professor ever! it doesnt even matter if you dont like biology you should take this class! its mostly lecture and it can get slightly boring but he really is the best. he always tries to help and reaches out to students. he teaches very well and with studying, you can definitely get an A!
Brinkerhoff is an excellent teacher. Very nice and thoughtful. He always tries to get students interested and involved. He is able to make complicated material very easy to understand.
Brinkerhoff is sooo nice and willing to help!!! Definitely one of the best teachers at U of R.

He was an amazing teacher! Always willing to help students outside of class. He offered tons of opportunities to get extra credit and all of his lectures are interesting and engaging. His slides are detailed and super easy to understand and he is always happy to answer questions

Brinkerhoff is awesome! he is so helpful and he is so interested in what he is teaching, pay attention and the class won't be hard at all... he is definitely a lot better at teaching Ecology than Smallwood... if Brinkerhoff is teaching Ecology, take it!!!
